objective: Test whether point-in-time football context reduces forward home-margin error versus the recorded market-implied home margin.

chronology.forecastEligibility: prospective forecastAt >= prospectiveStartAt and forecastAt < kickoffAt
chronology.grouping: rows with the same forecastAt are predicted together and are never in one another's training data

sourceRule: Every feature requires its value, <feature>AsOf, <feature>SourcePath, <feature>SourceSha256, <feature>ManifestPath, and <feature>ManifestSha256. Every manifest has a timezone-aware observedAt equal to the row source timestamp, is verified against its SHA-256, and every manifest-listed archived source file is re-hashed from the evidence archive.
notes: The reporting minima are inherited from the current S02 validation contract; satisfying them is not a promotion or delivery gate.
The inherited ridge alpha is a PRIOR, not an empirically optimized value. It is frozen to prevent tuning on the walk-forward outcomes.

Only rows after prospectiveStartAt count as evaluation predictions. Earlier rows may train only after their outcomes settle and only if every input timestamp and source-manifest hash passes validation.
This margin challenger does not produce cover probabilities, executable prices, picks, stakes, or a delivery card.
No feature-age cutoff is invented. Every feature timestamp is retained; a separately justified freshness rule requires a new freeze.
